'''The L-14 blaster pistol''' was a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] in use around the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
